json.name: Advanced Aerospace Alloys Data Catalog
json.description: A curated collection of datasets containing experimental and computational data for advanced metallic alloys, specifically those relevant to aerospace applications. Includes mechanical, thermal, and corrosion properties.

hasPart.name: High-Temperature Tensile Strength of Ti-6Al-4V
hasPart.description: Tensile strength data for Ti-6Al-4V alloy at various elevated temperatures and strain rates.

hasPart.name: Corrosion Resistance of Novel Al-Li Alloys
hasPart.description: Experimental data on the electrochemical corrosion rates of new Aluminum-Lithium alloys in simulated saltwater environments.

hasPart.name: Fatigue Life of Superalloys for Turbine Blades
hasPart.description: Cyclic fatigue life data and S-N curves for various nickel-based superalloys under high-cycle fatigue conditions.
